meta.title: Schedule for Later with a chosen start date and time
warnings: added set_schedule — the schedule is displayed but not committed until saved
added set_schedule — the schedule is displayed but not committed until saved

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the event.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required product line item so scheduling and publication are enabled.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: On the create screen, open the Schedule side panel, change Start time from Start now to Schedule for later, choose a future date in the calendar, choose or enter a future time, save the schedule, and stop with the schedule label visibly showing the chosen future start date and time

steps.note: Configure and verify the chosen future start, which has no dedicated absolute-start create-step equivalent.
Add a participant so the event can be published.
Publish the event using the configured future schedule.
Confirm publication reached a real event page.
Verify the event is not live before its scheduled start.
